cloneRelationship.relatedTo: BatchNFTMinter (predecessor single-token nudge helper; separate contract, not a staker-family clone)

story025Model.eligibility: count >= nudgeSize (nudgeSize==0 disables); qualifier receives ENTIRE pre-loop balance of every whitelisted token (winner-take-all, intended)
story025Model.donateForward: reward balances SNAPSHOTTED BEFORE mint loop, paid AFTER -- batch's own dispatcher donations stay behind to seed next claimant (load-bearing; test_OwnDonationsDoNotRefundToBatcher pins it)
story025Model.paymentTokenExclusion: admin-time: setNudgeTokenWhitelist derives payment token via _resolvePaymentPath (same path as batchMint) and reverts on match; runtime: _snapshotRewards SKIPs an entry equal to derived payment token (repoint tolerance, keeps batchMint live)
story025Model.duplicates: structurally impossible (set semantics, loud revert on re-add) -- closes audit-21 M-02 class
story025Model.minterPinned: tokenMinter + dispatcherIndex owner-set state (story-014 heritage); caller cannot supply minter -- fake-mint nudge drain closed
story025Model.minRewards: per-token floor vs PRE-LOOP snapshot, checked before any pull/mint; protects loser from minting into a drained pot; does NOT prevent front-run winner-take-all

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoops: caveat: mint loop bounded by caller count (caller pays own gas -- self-bounded); whitelist loops bounded by owner-managed _nudgeTokens length (owner-trusted)
verifiedProperties.pausable: only batchMint is whenNotPaused; all admin + rescueERC20 callable while paused
verifiedProperties.approvalHygiene: forceApprove(max) before loop, forceApprove(0) after -- no lingering approval
verifiedProperties.swapAndPop: setNudgeTokenWhitelist removal REORDERS list (documented; callers must re-fetch)
verifiedProperties.custodyWarning: contract is deliberately NOT custody: whitelisted balances sweepable by next qualifier; non-whitelisted tokens inert, recoverable only via rescueERC20

localFindings.description: minRewards[] binds to whitelist entries by INDEX. The length check (ArrayLengthMismatch) catches an owner add/remove that changes length, but an owner REMOVE+ADD pair (same length, different order via swap-and-pop) landing between the caller's getNudgeTokens() fetch and their batchMint binds the caller's floors to the WRONG tokens -- floors can silently under-protect. Requires an owner admin tx in the race window (non-malicious-owner footgun, ceiling Low/QA). Mitigation already documented ('re-fetch before every batchMint'); a (token,minReward) pair encoding would close it structurally.

Post-loop payment-token sweep sends the contract's ENTIRE remaining payment-token balance (>= DUST_THRESHOLD=1e6) to msg.sender -- including pre-existing donations/griefer deposits (documented as intended: 'donates to the next caller'). totalPaid uses saturating subtraction so a sweep larger than paymentAmount reports 0, not negative.

externalEntryPoints.function: batchMint(uint256 count, address recipient, uint256 paymentAmount, uint256[] minRewards)
externalCalls: nftMinter.mint(index, recipient) x count -- MINTS ERC1155 TO CALLER-CHOSEN recipient => potential onERC1155Received callback on ATTACKER-CONTROLLED recipient inside the loop (guarded by nonReentrant here; mint/supply state lives in the minter, not this contract)

externalEntryPoints.notes: UNCONDITIONAL (no floor) -- owner-trusted; escape hatch for non-whitelisted tokens

externalCalls.trustLevel: owner-vetted but EXECUTES ARBITRARY CODE if a bad token is whitelisted; nonReentrant fails it closed

methods: onERC1155Received via minter's mint, ERC20 receives

trustAssumptions: Owner whitelists only sane ERC20s (FoT/rebasing at owner's discretion, documented)

Nudge pot is by construction a fraction of nudgeSize mint cost -- every claim net-positive for protocol (run-21: NFT has NO redemption value, 6.7x margin; over-funding + bot snipe = sender error, wont-fix 858e9e80)
Dispatcher donates reward token here on every mint (funding mechanic)
